name: Chippewa River
gaugeName: CHIPPEWA RIVER AT CHIPPEWA FALLS, WI
blurb: Chippewa River paddles across Wisconsin, including short urban trips below Dells Dam in Eau Claire. Start at Forest Street or Phoenix Park and finish at Hobbs Landing, or explore other listed stretches. Several longer itineraries still have unresolved dam and portage questions.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

notices.title: Cornell Dam portage required
notices.text: The Cornell city ramp is above the dam. Use the established canoe/kayak carry on the west side to reach the downstream put-in. FERC describes a roughly 1,000-foot portage; Xcel’s recreation map shows its location. Stay away from the dam and use the designated re-entry, not the informal fishing area immediately below it. Confirm current access and signs before launching.

distanceEvidence.note: Approximate difference between the guide’s rounded endpoint river miles. The guide text calls the trail 2.7 miles and its current webpage says 4.2, without matching endpoints; neither headline is substituted for this named trip. Carries and shuttle time are excluded.

sections.routeReview: The dotted line shows the general river course below Dells Dam. Exact shoreline connections and passages around pilings, rocks and bridge hazards are not mapped.

notices.title: Check current and urban river hazards
notices.text: The linked 2016 guide identifies old lumber pilings, rapids near Lake Street Bridge and a rock ledge near Little Niagara Creek. Dells Dam releases can alter flow below the dam. Inspect current conditions; this course overview does not identify a safe passage between obstacles.
notices.sourceName: Visit Eau Claire — Chippewa River Water Trail guide

putInAccess.operator: City of Eau Claire
putInAccess.sourceName: City of Eau Claire landing list; Chippewa River Water Trail guide
putInAccess.note: The current city page documents canoe/kayak access. Its facility-map coordinate is on a building, so this area uses the unchanged access coordinate printed in the linked 2016 water-trail guide (Eau Claire Maintenance carry-in). Imagery places it beside the riverbank, but does not confirm the exact current landing.
putInAccess.directions: Use the city-listed canoe/kayak launch just south of the 910 Forest Street parking lot. Carry to the river from the signed public approach; do not enter the maintenance building or treat its street address as the landing. This launch is below Dells Dam.

takeOutAccess.operator: City of Eau Claire
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Visit Eau Claire — kayaking page and city water-trail guide
takeOutAccess.note: The tourism agency currently recommends Phoenix Park for launching. The unchanged guide coordinate lies just off the park tip in imagery, so retain an approximate access area. The park landmark at river mile 58.2 is distinct from the carry-in marked 58.1.
takeOutAccess.directions: Carry through Phoenix Park to the access at the Chippewa–Eau Claire River confluence. The guide identifies the downstream park tip near the pedestrian bridge. Inspect the usable shoreline and current before launching; the Area marker is not a vehicle destination or an exact landing.

sections.difficulty: Not rated; current, pilings and urban river hazards
sections.notes: Paddle through downtown Eau Claire to Hobbs Landing on river right. Expect old log pilings, rapids near Lake Street Bridge and the Little Niagara Creek rock ledge. Identify the exit in advance; the water-trail guide warns of additional hazards downstream of Hobbs.

notices.text: The 2016 city water-trail guide warns that hazards below Hobbs make this reach suitable only for expert paddlers. Treat that as a reason to inspect the present route and obtain current local guidance, not as a current difficulty rating or a cleared route.
notices.sourceName: Visit Eau Claire — Chippewa River Water Trail guide

putInAccess.operator: Eau Claire Park & Rec Dept. (ownership 'City' in the WDNR record)
putInAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR boat-access inventory; City of Eau Claire — Hobbs Landing
putInAccess.note: Unchanged DNR coordinate (BOATLANDING_SEQ_NO 986) matches the visible shoreline end of the landing approach. The city lists a paved boat landing and dock; the water-trail guide identifies this same takeout. Desktop agency/imagery review, not a field survey; water levels and the usable shore can change.
putInAccess.directions: Use Hobbs Landing behind the ice arena at 915 Menomonie Street. Follow the public approach to the shoreline landing and take out on river right, facing downstream. Arrange your vehicle shuttle before launching.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: Visit Eau Claire — Chippewa River Water Trail guide
putInAccess.bankNote: The guide explicitly directs paddlers to Hobbs on river right, facing downstream. Its mapped bank and the unchanged DNR point agree with imagery.
